verdict.rationale: EFTPS exists to pay federal taxes. Its own IRS and eftps.gov pages document online payment from home or office 24/7, covering income, employment, estimated and excise taxes, with scheduling up to 365 days ahead, changes and cancellations, and immediate acknowledgement. Onboarding is not fully online: enrollment ends with a PIN sent by U.S. Mail and can take up to five business days, and new individual enrollments are closed. Missing for 10: a fully online enrollment path (no mailed PIN), independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end online payment.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Make your tax payment from home or office, 24/7.
Pay your income, employment, estimated and excise federal tax payments.
You may use this Web site and our voice response system (1.800.555.3453) interchangeably to make payments.
Immediate acknowledgement of your payment along with your bank statement will confirm payments were made.
